title: Debug: The Bus That Never Lets Go

tests.name: subscribe fires, in order
tests.hint: Two subscribers: first registered, first invoked.

tests.name: unsubscribe detaches
tests.hint: After Unsubscribe(h), h must not run — this is the leak the broken version has.

tests.name: invocation counting is exact
